verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party AI automation for month-end close, such as AI categorization, reconciliation, or close workflows. Statement exports in accounting formats (CAMT.053, MT940, QIF), webhooks, and an llms.txt docs file are only building blocks a developer could use to construct such automation. They are not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI automations to close my books faster each month
